name: Fresh Cantaloupe Slices (Rockmelon)
whyItWorks: Cantaloupe is rich in beta-carotene and potassium (replenishing electrolytes lost to diarrhea) while featuring tender, silky flesh that breaks down rapidly in gastric acid. The interior seeds are easily scooped out completely.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ensure seeds and stringy center core are fully discarded. Slice the soft orange flesh into bite-sized cubes and eat chilled.
watchOuts: Eat in modest portions (1 cup) to keep total fructose load comfortably balanced.
